name: dev.ucp.shopping.incentives
title: Incentives Extension
description: Extends Catalog Search, Catalog Lookup, Cart, and Checkout with the offers a business is running: conditional, gated, code-based, or time-boxed promotions that cannot be expressed as a price on a variant. Response-only. Nothing here applies an offer; application stays with the Discount extension and the business remains authoritative on every amount.

period.title: Incentive Period
period.description: When an incentive is offered. Either bound may be omitted. Outside the period the incentive is not offered.

start_time.description: First instant the incentive is offered (RFC 3339). Omitted means already in effect.

end_time.description: Last instant the incentive is offered (RFC 3339). Omitted means no stated end.

benefit.title: Incentive Benefit
benefit.description: What the incentive gives, typed by `type`. Well-known types: `amount_off` (carries `amount`), `percent_off` (carries `basis_points`), `fixed_price` (carries `price`), `free_shipping` (optionally carries `fulfillment_option_ids`). The vocabulary is open; a platform MUST ignore an incentive whose benefit type it does not recognize.

type.description: Benefit kind. Well-known values: `amount_off`, `percent_off`, `fixed_price`, `free_shipping`. Businesses MAY use reverse-domain names for custom kinds.

amount.description: For `amount_off`: the amount taken off, in the response currency. Off each targeted item; off the order subtotal when the incentive has no `targets` on a cart or checkout.

basis_points.description: For `percent_off`: the percentage taken off, in basis points (`1250` = 12.5%).

price.description: For `fixed_price`: what each targeted variant costs while the incentive applies.

fulfillment_option_ids.description: For `free_shipping`: the fulfillment options whose cost becomes zero. Omitted means any option.

conditions.title: Incentive Conditions
conditions.description: What must hold for the incentive to apply. All stated conditions must hold. Conditions are evaluated by the business at application; a platform MAY evaluate the ones it can to decide what to show.

minimum_order_amount.description: Order subtotal the buyer must reach, in the response currency.

minimum_quantity.description: Units of a targeted variant the buyer must purchase.

eligibility.description: An eligibility claim the buyer must hold and the business must accept, as in `context.eligibility` and `discounts.applied[].eligibility`.

scopes.description: Scopes the buyer's session must hold. Lets a business state that a gated price exists without resolving it for a caller that lacks the scope.

targets.title: Incentive Targets
targets.description: What the incentive applies to. Every id MUST name an entity present in the same response. Omitted means every product, variant, or line item in the response.

incentive.title: Incentive
incentive.description: One offer a business is running. Advisory until the business applies it at cart or checkout; `discounts.applied` is the record of what took effect.

id.description: Identifier, stable for this business. `approaching` entries and later responses refer to it.

title.description: Human-readable name, e.g. 'Free standard shipping over $50'.

description.description: Terms in plain, HTML, or Markdown form.

active_period.description: When the incentive is offered. Omitted means always on.

conditions.description: What must hold for it to apply. Omitted means unconditional.

targets.description: What it applies to. Omitted means everything in the response.

application.description: `automatic` is applied by the business when the conditions hold. `code` requires the buyer to submit a code through `discounts.codes`.

code.description: The code to submit, when `application` is `code` and the business chooses to disclose it. Absent with `application: code` means the buyer must already hold one.

combinable.description: False means the incentive does not stack with others. Advisory; the business decides stacking at application.

provisional.description: True if the incentive requires verification the business cannot do at this point, as in `discounts.applied[].provisional`.

approaching.title: Approaching Incentive
approaching.description: An incentive the current cart or checkout does not yet qualify for, with how far it is from qualifying.

remaining_amount.description: Subtotal still needed to meet `minimum_order_amount`, in the response currency.

incentives.title: Incentives
incentives.description: The incentives that apply to the entities in this response.

available.description: Incentives the business is offering on what it returned.

session_incentives.title: Session Incentives
session_incentives.description: The incentives that apply to this cart or checkout, and the ones it is close to qualifying for.

available.description: Incentives the business is offering on this session, whether or not it qualifies yet.

approaching.description: Entries of `available` the session does not yet qualify for, with the remaining gap.

dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.search.description: Catalog search composition with incentives (extends dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.search).

dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.lookup.description: Catalog lookup composition with incentives (extends dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.lookup).

dev.ucp.shopping.cart.title: Cart with Incentives
dev.ucp.shopping.cart.description: Cart extended with the incentives that apply to it.

dev.ucp.shopping.checkout.title: Checkout with Incentives
dev.ucp.shopping.checkout.description: Checkout extended with the incentives that apply to it.
